name: @lycan-sync/web
description: LycanSync 语音、屏幕共享与群聊客户端
author: Wreckloud

scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:media && npm run build:media-bridge && npm run build:activity && npm run build:obs && npm run build
scripts.package:desktop: npm run build:desktop && node ../../native/obs-capture-host/package-source.cjs && node electron/package-desktop.cjs
scripts.test:electron-unit: node --test electron/media-helper.test.cjs electron/obs-capture-host.test.cjs electron/native-video-preload.test.cjs electron/media-diagnostics.test.cjs electron/capture-permissions.test.cjs electron/server-settings.test.cjs electron/access-links.test.cjs electron/api-proxy.test.cjs electron/startup-update.test.cjs electron/activity-helper.test.cjs electron/voice-overlay.test.cjs electron/window-layout.test.cjs electron/screen-share-windows.test.cjs ../../native/obs-capture-host/package-source.test.cjs
scripts.test: npm run typecheck:test && vitest run src tests/unit
scripts.test:desktop: npm run build:desktop && npm run typecheck:test && playwright test --config playwright.desktop.config.ts
